title: Range vs ATR
summary: How often the session's high-to-low range reached at least r times the prior 14-session average true range. The denominator is sessions with an ATR on record: the first fourteen sessions of a series have none and are excluded, not zero-filled; the numerator is the ones whose range-to-ATR ratio met the threshold. The ATR uses strictly prior sessions, so as a condition elsewhere it is knowable before the open; here, the attached ratio distribution is the full volatility profile of which this rate is one cut.

params.name: r
params.doc: Range threshold in multiples of the prior 14-session ATR.

deltas: r is continuous: expansion is your threshold, not a preset author's
the ratio distribution shows the whole profile in one run
warm-up sessions are excluded from the denominator, not silently zeroed
